notes: Cancelled for v1 (AUTH #020 / ADR-0006): no avatar vendor in v1 (pre-made characters). Avatar SDK/MetaPerson research retained for the V2 custom-avatar track.
summary: Collect Avatar SDK/MetaPerson (itSeez3D) data-retention, training, deletion, and DPA terms and confirm fit for M2. Per AUTH #019 / ADR-0005 the head vendor is Avatar SDK on-prem 'Local Compute' (replaces Meshy/Tripo, dropped). Confirm the on-prem/no-train + DPA path before any face processing.

acceptance_tests.test: legal/vendors/avatar-sdk.md records retention, deletion path, training-by-default and the on-prem/no-train option, DPA availability, region, with quotes, links, retrieval date.

An Avatar SDK/MetaPerson dossier (recognizability, generation time, Unity/iOS SDK, on-prem Local Compute, deletion guarantees, biometric-specific terms) confirms fit for M2; the head vendor is Avatar SDK (AUTH #019).
Any vendor that trains on customer images by default without an opt-out is marked 'do not use for user data'.

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording
Owner selected Meshy as the head vendor (already holds an account); Tripo dropped. Scope reduced to a Meshy terms dossier; deliverables and acceptance tests updated to Meshy-only.

Meshy dossier landed (legal/vendors/meshy.md + research/vendors/meshy.md). Red flags: trains on non-Enterprise inputs by default; ToS bans identifiable-person photos; Free output is CC BY 4.0. Decision: USABLE WITH CONDITIONS (Enterprise + DPA + no-train + immediate source-photo deletion + PII carve-out; paid tier). Vendor-confirmed terms still required (§6.3) — status stays open.

Head vendor switched to Avatar SDK/MetaPerson on-prem (AUTH #019 / ADR-0005) — Meshy dropped after research showed its ToS bans identifiable-person photos. Retargeted title, summary, deliverable (legal/vendors/avatar-sdk.md), and AT-1/AT-2 to Avatar SDK; avatar-sdk.md filed from public terms. On-prem + DPA still to confirm (§6.3) — status stays open.
